name: Culled Voxel Meshing
aliases: Visible Face Generation with Boundary Policy
definition: Generates geometry for voxels but culls faces that are adjacent to other solid voxels, based on a boundary policy.
summary: Culled Voxel Meshing generates a single mesh by omitting shared faces and explicitly handling chunk boundaries via a BoundaryPolicy, emitting individual unit quads rather than merging coplanar faces.
